findings:
ULTRASOUND SCAN OF SOFT TISSUE

Mild hypertrophy of subcutaneous fat is noted in the region of the swelling in the lumbosacral region and is seen to continue with spinal canal - possibly lipomeningocele.

A linear echogenic tract is noted in the extramedullary intradural compartment immediately posterior to filum terminale with AP measurement 2.1 mm.

Conus medullaris appears low lying.

IMPRESSION
"	Features are likely suggestive of spina bifida occulta with lipomeningocele. 
"	Linear echogenic tract in extramedullary intradural compartment as detailed.
"	Low lying conus medullaris.
o	Suggested MRI LS spine for further detailed evaluation.
